results.title: Deploy VotingSystem.sol; inspect initial state
results.expected: electionOpen = false; admin = deployer

results.title: castVote() while election is closed
results.expected: Reverts: "Election is not open"

results.title: openElection() called by a non-admin account
results.expected: Reverts: "Only admin can perform this action"

results.title: Admin opens election; first valid castVote()
results.expected: Tx mined; VoteCast(voterHash, boothId) emitted; tally = 1; hash flagged

results.title: Same voter ID submits a second vote
results.expected: Reverts: "Voter has already voted"; tally unchanged

results.title: Five distinct voters vote for two candidates; getResults()
results.expected: Counts tally exactly (A = 3, B = 2)

results.title: castVote() after admin calls closeElection()
results.expected: Reverts: "Election is not open"

results.title: castVote() after the configured end timestamp
results.expected: Reverts: "Election period has ended"

results.title: castVote() sent directly from a non-relayer address
results.expected: Reverts: "Only admin can perform this action"

results.title: Repository compile settings (evmVersion shanghai) on Ganache 7.9.2; read candidateList() and getResults()
results.expected: Both reads succeed; hasVoted(hash) works

results.title: Login with a wrong password
results.expected: 401 "Invalid credentials"; attempt counter +1; LOGIN_FAILED logged

results.title: Five consecutive wrong passwords, then the correct one
results.expected: 5th attempt: 423 and ACCOUNT_LOCKED (30 min); correct password still refused

results.title: Correct Voter ID and password
results.expected: 200; 6-digit OTP stored; OTP_SENT logged; no JWT yet

results.title: Wrong OTP three times, then the correct OTP
results.expected: 401 (2, 1, 0 attempts left); 4th attempt 429 even if correct

results.title: OTP presented after its 300 s lifetime
results.expected: 410 "OTP expired"

results.title: Login + correct OTP (fresh voter)
results.expected: 200 + JWT (30 min, voterId, boothId, jti); OTP consumed

results.title: Logout, then reuse the same JWT
results.expected: 401 "Session expired or logged out"

results.title: Voter-role token on an admin-only route
results.expected: 403 "Admin access required"; admin roles pass

results.title: Voter casts a ballot while the election is closed
results.expected: 403 "Election is not open"; no on-chain vote

results.title: Ballot for a candidate ID that does not exist
results.expected: 404 "Candidate not found"

results.title: Valid ballot (live mode, real Ganache node)
results.expected: 200; real 32-byte tx hash mined (status 1); DB flag set; VOTE_CAST logged; vote:update emitted

results.title: Same voter votes again (database layer)
results.expected: 403 "You have already voted"; chain tally still 1

results.title: Database flag cleared (out of sync); voter votes again
results.expected: 403 "Already voted on blockchain"; chain tally still 1

results.title: Inspect calldata and audit record of the accepted ballot from TC-21
results.expected: Calldata holds keccak256(voterId), not the ID; candidate ID still plaintext; VOTE_CAST actor is a SHA-256 hash, no candidateId

results.title: Candidate list requested by voters of two different booths
results.expected: Each sees own-booth + no-booth candidates only

results.title: Admin deletes a voter who has already voted
results.expected: 400 "Cannot delete voter who has already voted"

results.title: Admin deletes a candidate while the election is open
results.expected: 400 "Cannot delete candidate while election is open"

results.title: Mock mode (placeholder .env): open election, cast ballot, no node running
results.expected: 200; election state kept in ElectionState; receipt is a random placeholder, not a mined 32-byte hash

results.title: Live mode, Ganache node goes offline, then a ballot is cast
results.expected: 500 "Blockchain transaction failed"; voter not marked as voted; VOTE_REJECTED logged
